title: fix: read KPI app submissions from the daily GitHub snapshot
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Fixed the KPI dashboard’s missing GitHub app-submissions series. The daily GitHub snapshot now uses its token to count APP-SUBMISSION issues by UTC week and writes github-app-submissions.json to kpi-data, rewriting it only when counts change. /api/kpi/app-submissions reads the snapshot instead of paging GitHub anonymously on every dashboard load, avoiding shared-IP rate limits and whole-series failures when a page request fails. The current week updates daily rather than live, and the tooltip says so; the table uses only finished weeks. Failed snapshot reads are not cached, so the panel can recover when the file becomes available. The script was renamed to snapshot-github.mjs; the workflow’s schedule and permissions are unchanged. A dry run counted 541 submissions across 22 weeks in 11 API calls.
